lines.en: label springtime5:
scene wearegoingtovisit1
: Hey. So, remember that time I said we’d be seeing our creepy teacher tomorrow? But then a whole bunch of tomorrows happened and we still haven’t seen him? And now tomorrow’s Christmas?
lines.zh: : 嘿。还记得那次我说我们明天就能见到我们那个变态老师吗？结果一大堆「明天」过去了，我们还是没见到他？而现在明天就是圣诞节了？

lines.en: : Yes, Maya. I do remember that. And I applaud your ability to keep track of time now that time actually somewhat {i}matters{/i} to you again.
lines.zh: : 记得，Maya。我当然记得。而且我很欣赏你现在能记清时间了——既然时间对你来说又多少有点意义了。

lines.en: : Thanks. But what does that mean for {i}you?{/i} Because {i}I’m{/i} totally fine, but {i}you’re{/i} still acting like you just watched a puppy getting curb-stomped outside of your bedroom window.
lines.zh: : 谢了。可那对你意味着什么？因为我完全没事，可你还一副刚在卧室窗外看完一只小狗被踩在路边暴打的样子。

lines.en: : Part of me wants to call you a psychopath for using such a specific analogy to describe me. Yet, the rest of me is impressed that you managed to describe my current state of mind so perfectly.
lines.zh: : 我有一部分想因为你用这么具体的比喻来形容我而叫你精神病。可另一部分又很佩服——你居然把我此刻的心境描述得这么准。

lines.en: : I guess I’ve gotten to know you pretty well over the last seven weeks since you’ve decided to sew yourself onto my hip. I wouldn’t blame you for cutting the stitches, though.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为过去七周你非要把自己缝在我身上，我对你已经挺了解了。不过你要想把线剪断，我也不会怪你。

lines.en: : In fact, I encourage it. Please set me free so I can go back to only existing when I want to exist. Which is almost never, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我鼓励你那么做。请放我自由，好让我回到「只在我想要存在的时候才存在」的状态。现在想想，那几乎是永远不存在。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不要。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit2
: What do you mean “no?” You can’t just randomly strip my free will one day and then go blaming it on time travel instead of giving me a proper explanation.
lines.zh: : 「不要」是什么意思？你不能某天随随便便剥夺了我的自由意志，然后把它赖到时间旅行头上，还不给我一个像样的解释。

lines.en: : We’ve been spending entirely too much time together lately and I’m starting to think you might just secretly have feelings for me.
lines.zh: : 我们最近待在一起的时间实在太多了，我开始怀疑你其实偷偷对我有感觉。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit3
: I’m straight, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我是异性恋，Maya。

lines.en: : Everyone is straight until they’re not.
lines.zh: : 每个人在不是之前，都是异性恋。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But this is me formally requesting an unpaid leave of absence so I don’t have to listen to your maniacal ramblings for at least the next...week or so.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。不过我现在正式申请无薪休假，好让我至少在接下来……一周左右里不用听你那些疯子般的长篇大论。

lines.en: : I will also accept a paid leave of absence in lieu of an unpaid one if that’s the way things must be. I just want to be alone again.
lines.zh: : 如果非这样不可，我也可以接受带薪休假来代替无薪的。我只是想再一个人待着。

lines.en: : Do you really not care about Sensei? Neither of us have seen him since the day after Halloween. He could be a total wreck for all we know.
lines.zh: : 你真的不在乎 Sensei 吗？万圣节次日之后我们俩谁都没见过他。说不定他已经彻底崩溃了，我们根本不知道。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit4
: {i}Him?{/i} A wreck? Please. The most emotion I’ve ever seen out of that guy was a slight scowl when I borrowed his wallet for a solo takoyaki party. And even that only lasted a couple seconds.
lines.zh: : {i}他{/i}？崩溃？得了吧。我从那家伙身上见过最多的情绪，就是我借走他的钱包去办一个人的章鱼烧派对时，他微微皱了下眉。而且那也只持续了几秒钟。

lines.en: : It all just feels so...wrong.
lines.zh: : 这一切感觉太……不对劲了。

lines.en: : I know Ami’s taking care of him, but not even letting us {i}see{/i} him just feels...sketchy. Don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 我知道 Ami 在照顾他，可连让我们见他一面都不肯，总觉得……有点可疑。你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Yeah well, expecting to be able to rationalize the actions and mannerisms of a girl who wants to harbor her uncle’s children isn’t something that one would assume to be easy.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过指望能合理化一个想怀着自己叔叔的孩子的女孩的举动和做派，本来就不是什么容易的事。

lines.en: : Did you want to try again today?
lines.zh: : 你今天想再试一次吗？

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit5
: You’re really going to make me walk all the way over there just to get turned away like {i}every other time{/i} we’ve tried this?
lines.zh: : 你真要让我大老远走过去，就为了像之前每一次那样被赶回来？

lines.en: : It’s Christmas Eve. Maybe Ami is...feeling generous or something.
lines.zh: : 今天是平安夜。也许 Ami……心情大发慈悲之类的。

lines.en: : Or maybe you’re just desperate to see another puppy get curb-stomped. Going over there isn’t going to accomplish anything. It’s a waste of time.
lines.zh: : 或者也许你只是迫不及待想再看一只小狗被踩。过去那儿不会有任何结果。纯属浪费时间。

lines.en: : Even if it {i}is{/i} a waste of time, I’m not the type who can just sit back and...not do anything when someone I love is in trouble.
lines.zh: : 就算那是浪费时间，我也不是那种能在我爱的人遇到麻烦时坐视不管……什么都不做的人。

lines.en: : I don’t need to be able to {i}help{/i} or...or even {i}talk{/i} to him for that matter. At this point, I’d be happy just seeing that he’s alive and not completely wiped from existence like Maya-Prime was.
lines.zh: : 我不需要能帮上忙，甚至……甚至不需要能跟他说上话。到了这一步，只要能看到他还活着、没有像初代 Maya 那样被彻底从存在中抹掉，我就心满意足了。

lines.en: : Are you implying that I am somehow {i}sub-{/i}prime? Because there are girls all over the world who would {i}kill{/i} for my looks and personality.
lines.zh: : 你这是在暗示我算是{i}次{/i}品吗？全世界的女孩可是会为了我的长相和性格去杀人的。

lines.en: : At least your ego hasn’t changed much.
lines.zh: : 至少你的自恋没怎么变。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit6
: Hah...fine. We can go to Ami’s stupid house again once school is over. But I’m tired of trying to distract her while you fiddle with the six million locks she put on his door.
lines.zh: : 哈……行吧。放学后我们就再去一趟 Ami 那破房子。不过我受够了在你摆弄她给房门装的六百万把锁时，负责分散她的注意力。

lines.en: : We go in, ask if we can talk to him, get rejected, and leave. Sound good? Good. Meeting adjourned.
lines.zh: : 我们进去，问能不能跟他说话，被拒绝，然后走人。听着不错？不错。散会。

lines.en: : Thank you, Maya.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Maya。

lines.en: : And, for the record, I don’t think you’re {i}sub-{/i}prime. I just miss the {i}you{/i} I spent so much time with and...even if you’re a fragment of that person, this will still take some getting used to for me.
lines.zh: : 还有，我声明一下，我不觉得你是{i}次{/i}品。我只是想念那个和我共度了那么多时光的你……而即便你只是那个人的一个碎片，我也还是需要时间去适应。

lines.en: : Can’t see why. The {i}me{/i} you keep bringing up all the time sounded all...boring and bitchy. But I {i}do{/i} admire her apparent affinity for secrecy and am glad to hear her love for melons never faded.
lines.zh: : 看不出有什么好适应的。你老挂在嘴边的那个{i}我{/i}听起来……又无聊又刻薄。不过我确实挺佩服她那种对秘密的执着，也很高兴听说她对蜜瓜的热爱从未消退。

lines.en: : I wish it was possible for you to meet her. I think you would have liked seeing how all those years and timelines changed you. There was a lot to like about my Maya.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你们能见上一面。我觉得你会想看看，那么多年、那么多时间线是怎么改变了你的。我那个 Maya 有很多讨人喜欢的地方。

lines.en: : And a lot to abhor as well, I’m sure. But I suppose I’ll leave the rest of that discussion for three hours from now when you inevitably bring it back up.
lines.zh: : 肯定也有不少招人恨的地方。不过剩下的话题我想还是留到三小时后你必然旧事重提的时候再聊吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Until then, all we can do is wait for school to end.
lines.zh: : 在那之前，我们能做的只有等放学。

lines.en: : And figure out how we’re going to handle Ami once we see her...
lines.zh: : 还有想好等见到 Ami 该怎么应付她……

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I’ll leave that part to you.
lines.zh: : 那部分我交给你了。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit7
: Helloooo?...
lines.zh: : 有人吗？……
: Ami？……

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : Is anyone home?
lines.zh: : 有人在吗？

lines.en: : Guess not. Time to leave. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 看来没有。该走了。我们走吧。

lines.en: : We can’t leave yet. If Ami {i}isn’t{/i} here, I might actually be able to get us into Sensei’s room. Even if he’s out as well, there might be some sort of...clue in there.
lines.zh: : 还不能走。如果 Ami 不在，我说不定真能让我们进到 Sensei 的房间。就算他也不在，里面也许有什么……线索。

lines.en: : You do that, Nancy Drew. I’ll wait here and {i}not{/i} commit a felony. Which, honestly, we might already be doing since I’m pretty sure Ami doesn’t want you to have a key to her house right now.
lines.zh: : 那你干吧，南希·德鲁。我在这儿等着，坚决不犯重罪。说实话，我们可能已经在犯了，因为我很确定 Ami 现在并不想让你有她家的钥匙。

lines.en: : Right now, my key to this house is the one thing keeping the flame of hope alive in my heart.
lines.zh: : 此刻，这栋房子的钥匙是唯一还让我心中希望之火不灭的东西。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit8
: Have you always been this corny? Or did living through several apparent apocalypses cause you to give up entirely on the idea of comedy?
lines.zh: : 你一直都这么肉麻吗？还是说经历了几场所谓的末日之后，你干脆彻底放弃了幽默这个概念？

lines.en: : This is a tough time for me, okay? Leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 我现在很难熬，好吗？别烦我。

lines.en: : What are you two doing here?
lines.zh: : 你们俩在这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit9
: Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: : Should have left when we had the chance.
lines.zh: : 早知道有机会的时候就该走了。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit10
: I told you to warn me before coming over.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说过，来之前要先通知我。

lines.en: : You didn’t warn me at all.
lines.zh: : 你一点都没通知我。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Ami...we want to see Sensei.
lines.zh: : Ami……我们想见 Sensei。

lines.en: : He’s not feeling well right now.
lines.zh: : 他现在身体不舒服。

lines.en: : Yeah. He wasn’t feeling well the other trillion times I came over here either.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我来这儿的其他一万亿次，他也都是身体不舒服。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit11
: Then maybe you’re bad luck and it’s {i}your{/i} fault he’s sick! Teehee!
lines.zh: : 那也许你是扫把星，他生病是你的错！嘻嘻！

lines.en: : Ami...it’s been nearly two months. If Sensei still isn’t feeling well, you might want to consider taking him to the hospital so-
lines.zh: : Ami……都快两个月了。如果 Sensei 还是不舒服，你也许该考虑带他去医院——

lines.en: : Are you telling me I don’t know what I’m doing?
lines.zh: : 你是在说我不知道自己在做什么吗？

lines.en: : That’s not what I-
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思——

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit12
: I don’t care what you’re saying. This is {i}my{/i} house and you are going to follow {i}my{/i} rules while you’re inside of it.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎你说什么。这是我的房子，你在这儿就得守我的规矩。

lines.en: : I may have been more lenient when Sensei was healthy, but he {i}needs{/i} me right now. And if you are trying to get in the way of that, I won’t be very kind to you.
lines.zh: : Sensei 健康的时候我也许更宽容，可他现在需要我。要是你敢碍事，我可不会对你客气。

lines.en: : Why would I ever want to get in the way of that? I love Sensei. He means everything to me.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会想碍这种事？我爱 Sensei。他就是我的一切。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Then, would you die for him?
lines.zh: : 那么，你愿意为他去死吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : If the two of you were walking down the sidewalk and a car flipped over the guardrail and started barreling toward you, would you push him out of the way and sacrifice your life so he can live?
lines.zh: : 如果你们俩走在人行道上，一辆车翻过护栏朝你们冲过来，你会把他推开、牺牲自己的性命让他活下来吗？

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不——

lines.en: : If you were hostages in a bank robbery and someone needed to die in order to get the negotiators to listen, would you offer up yourself in his place?
lines.zh: : 如果你们在银行劫案里被劫持，必须有人死才能让谈判人员听话，你会替他去死吗？

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : If your god demanded fresh meat in exchange for power and safety, how likely would you be to allow the complete consumption of your body in place of Sensei’s? And which god would you be feeding?
lines.zh: : 如果你的神要求用新鲜的肉来换取力量与庇护，你有多大可能愿意让自己的身体被彻底吞噬，来替代 Sensei 的？你又会喂给哪一位神？

lines.en: : This is exactly why I said I didn’t want to be a part of this.
lines.zh: : 我所以说不想掺和进来，就是这个原因。

lines.en: : Just let me see him, Ami...Please. As a friend.
lines.zh: : 就让我见见他吧，Ami……求你了。作为朋友。

lines.en: : Now, {i}why{/i} would I do that?
lines.zh: : 那么，我{i}为什么{/i}要那么做？

lines.en: : Because I’m worried! It’s been almost two months! Christmas is tomorrow! You haven’t even decorated the house yet! What’s going on?!
lines.zh: : 因为我担心啊！都快两个月了！明天就是圣诞节！你连房子都还没装饰！到底怎么回事？！

lines.en: : Decorate?...
: You expect me to...decorate?...
lines.zh: : 你指望我去……装饰？……

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit13
: At a time like this?...
lines.zh: : 在这种时候？……

lines.en: : My uncle is fighting the greatest battle he’s faced in a {i}very{/i} long time right now, and you’re concerned about a lack of....{i}decorations?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我叔叔正在打一场他很久很久以来最艰难的仗，而你却在担心缺少……装饰品？

lines.en: : Are you fucking dense?
lines.zh: : 你是他妈的脑子有坑吗？

lines.en: : It was just...an example, Ami. Tomorrow is a special day and, while the rest of Kumon-mi is about to celebrate, you’re over here pretending it’s still November 1st.
lines.zh: : 那只是……打个比方，Ami。明天是个特别的日子，当整个 Kumon-mi 都在准备庆祝的时候，你却在这儿假装现在还是 11 月 1 日。

lines.en: : I’m over here keeping someone {i}alive.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我在这儿是让一个人活下去。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit14
: And it’s starting to sound like you might have a problem with that.
lines.zh: : 而听起来，你似乎对此有意见。

lines.en: : Just let me see him...please. And you’ll never have to get me another Christmas present again.
lines.zh: : 就让我见见他……求你了。这样你以后再也不用给我买圣诞礼物了。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit15
: Because there’s nothing to see.
lines.zh: : 因为没什么可看的。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit11
: Sensei just needs a little more time by himself until he’s feeling confident and safe enough to leave his room! And I, his beloved niece, am doing everything in my power to help with that!
lines.zh: : Sensei 只是还需要多一点独处的时间，等他有足够的自信和安全感走出房间！而我，他最亲爱的侄女，正在尽我所能地帮他！

lines.en: : So I appreciate the concern, but if you keep trying to disrupt his healing process, I’m going to have to call the police and make sure you’re never allowed to set foot in this house again! Okay? Okay!
lines.zh: : 所以谢谢你的关心，但如果你一直试图打扰他的康复过程，我就只好报警，确保你永远不能再踏进这栋房子！好吗？好吗！

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit16
: Can we leave a message at least?
lines.zh: : 那我们至少能留个口信吗？

lines.en: : I suppose that depends on what the message is.
lines.zh: : 我想那要看口信是什么。

lines.en: : Hey, don’t look at me. Ayane’s the one who wants to see the guy. I’m just here for moral support.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别看我。想见那家伙的是 Ayane。我只是来精神支持的。

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Just...tell him we miss him. And that we want him back as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 就……告诉他我们想他。还有我们希望他尽快回来。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit10
: And...and that it’s okay if he takes his time! But myself and everyone else would really appreciate it if he could just...communicate to us in some way that he’s doing okay!
lines.zh: : 还有……还有他慢慢来也没关系！但我和其他所有人都会非常感激，只要他能……用某种方式让我们知道他还好！

lines.en: : You don’t trust me, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不信任我，对吧？

lines.en: : You think I’m keeping Sensei locked away because I’m crazy. Because I’m obsessed. That’s what you think, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我把 Sensei 关起来，是因为我疯了。因为我病态地执着。你就是这么想的，不是吗？

lines.en: : And you know what? Maybe you’re right. Maybe I {i}am{/i} crazy. Because I’m {i}definitely{/i} obsessed, and those two things aren’t that far apart, are they?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？也许你是对的。也许我确实疯了。因为我百分之百是执着的，而这两样东西本来就没差多远，不是吗？

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit17
: But I’m {i}allowed{/i} to be crazy. Ami Arakawa’s a real sob story.
lines.zh: : 但我有资格疯。Ami Arakawa 本身就是一出苦情戏。

lines.en: : Once a certain amount of bad things happen to you, people tend to start giving you a free pass when it comes to acting a little differently than others.
lines.zh: : 一旦你身上发生了足够多的坏事，人们往往就会开始给你一张通行证，允许你表现得跟别人有点不一样。

lines.en: : It would have been nice if there was something I could have traded for that that didn’t also birth me, though.
lines.zh: : 不过要是有什么别的东西能换到这张通行证、而不是顺便把我生出来就好了。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : If there’s nothing else you’d like to leave in the message, would you kindly get the fuck out of my house now? And never come here again without asking me first?
lines.zh: : 如果口信没有别的要补充的，能麻烦你现在就他妈滚出我家吗？还有，以后没先问过我就永远别再来？

lines.en: : You can’t keep him here forever, Ami...He’s going to have to leave some day.
lines.zh: : 你不可能把他永远关在这儿，Ami……他总有一天得走出去。

lines.en: : That’s for him to decide. Not you.
lines.zh: : 那由他决定。不是你。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit11
{i}THERE IS A KNOCK AT THE DOOR{/i}
lines.zh: {i}门口传来了敲门声{/i}

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 请进！

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit18
: Oh! It’s my queen and her little sister — two people who did what they were supposed to do and called me before showing up at my house! I sure wish my {b}BEST FRIENDS{/b} would do the same!
lines.zh: : 哦！是我的女王和她的妹妹——两位照规矩办事、上门前先给我打了电话的人！我真希望我的好朋友们也能这么做！

lines.en: : Hey, Ami. Is Akira still-
lines.zh: : 嘿，Ami。Akira 还是——

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit19
: Uhh...
scene wearegoingtovisit20
scene wearegoingtovisit21
: Is Akira still not feeling well?
lines.zh: : Akira 还是不舒服吗？

lines.en: : What the fuck was {i}that{/i} about?
lines.zh: : 那是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Sensei is probably asleep right now. He had a long morning. But if you guys want to leave your presents on the dining room table, I’ll make sure he knows they were from you.
lines.zh: : Sensei 现在大概在睡觉。他今天早上很累。不过你们要是想把礼物放在餐桌上，我会让他知道是你们送的。

lines.en: : Is there any word on when he’ll be coming back to school by any chance? Because I’m pretty sure Imani is at the end of her rope. And Wakana- er...Miss Watabe’s seemed a little off as well.
lines.zh: : 有没有听说他什么时候回学校？因为我很确定 Imani 已经快撑不住了。还有 Wakana——呃……Watabe 老师看起来也有点不对劲。

lines.en: : Nope! But I’ll still be showing up every once in a while to pick up all the homework and stuff. Can’t let being a full-time caretaker spoil my education of course!
lines.zh: : 没有！不过我还是会时不时去拿作业什么的。当然不能让全职看护耽误了我的学业！

lines.en: : Which isn’t to say my grades are impressive at all, but...yeah.
lines.zh: : 当然这也不代表我的成绩有多好，不过……是啊。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit22

: You know I wouldn’t mind helping as well, right? Any time he caught a cold when we were little, I’d go over to his place and watch over him until he felt better. So I’ve got some experience already.
lines.zh: : 你知道我也不介意帮忙，对吧？小时候他每次感冒，我都会去他家守着他直到他好起来。所以我已经有些经验了。

lines.en: : And yes, I am aware that is completely different from whatever brand of mental breakdown he is having this time, but I’d still like to be there for him if possible.
lines.zh: : 是的，我知道这跟他这次那种精神崩溃完全不是一回事，不过如果可以的话，我还是想陪在他身边。

lines.en: : That’s very sweet of you, Niki!
lines.zh: : 你真是太贴心了，Niki！

lines.en: : But no.
lines.zh: : 但是不行。

lines.en: : This is something I should probably handle on my own.
lines.zh: : 这件事大概该由我一个人来处理。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit23
: If you say so. I’m assuming going into his room is still forbidden as well?
lines.zh: : 既然你这么说。那进他房间应该也还是禁止的吧？

lines.en: : That is correct. Please do not approach the door. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 没错。请不要靠近那扇门。谢谢。

lines.en: : Guess I’ll just leave all these here then. Have him call me if he’s ever feeling up to it, please. I’ve been so caught up worrying about him that I’ve barely even been able to work lately.
lines.zh: : 那我就把这些都留在这儿吧。等他哪天精神好些了，请让他给我打个电话。我最近担心他担心得几乎没法工作。

lines.en: : Yeah...even {i}my{/i} Insta is getting flooded with comments about how this is the first Christmas in a zillion years without a Niki concert.
lines.zh: : 是啊……连我的 Insta 都被评论刷屏了，说这是无数年来第一个没有 Niki 演唱会的圣诞节。

lines.en: : Imagine what they’d be saying if they found out it was because of a boy.
lines.zh: : 想象一下，要是他们发现是因为一个男人，会说什么。

lines.en: scene wearegoingtovisit24
: I can tell them if you want? We can watch the sparks fly from our phones instead of the fireworks this year. Might be fun.
lines.zh: : 要不要我去告诉他们？今年我们就在手机上看火花四溅，不看烟花了。说不定挺有意思。

lines.en: : Better idea — why don’t you and your friends go play as close to the fireworks as you can possibly get and-
lines.zh: : 更好的主意——你和你的朋友们不如去离烟花尽可能近的地方玩，然后——

lines.en: : Excuse me, Nakayama sisters, but Sensei needs his rest. So if there’s nothing else you need, please drop your presents off and vacate the premises. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，Nakayama 姐妹，Sensei 需要休息。如果没别的事，请放下礼物然后离开。谢谢。

lines.en: scene black
: Tch...fine. Is here okay?
lines.zh: : 啧……行吧。放这儿可以吗？

lines.en: : Dining room table, please! Next to the rest of stuff the others have dropped off.
lines.zh: : 请放餐桌上！挨着其他人放下的那些东西。

lines.en: : {i}Psst, Ayane...you good? You seem down. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘘，Ayane……你没事吧？你看起来很低落。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m fine...
lines.zh: : 我没事……

lines.en: : My chest is just a little tight.
lines.zh: : 只是胸口有点闷。
